rulebook.text: Domain does not depend on Contracts.
Application may use own Contracts but not foreign Contracts.
Adapters use only registered provider Contracts.
Public contracts and events live in provider Contracts namespaces.
Contracts do not reference framework or transport implementations.
Contracts do not contain implementation declarations.
Integration event payloads do not expose internal entities.
No new Abstractions project is introduced.
